question.problem:
Suppose we wish to find a critical point of the function $f(x,y)$ in the region $[1,2]\times [-2,1]⊆{R}^{2},$ where $$ f(x,y)=2{x}^{2}y+4{x}^{2}-3xy-8x. $$ Calculate the second iteration of the Newton-Raphson process for optimization that starts at ${x}_{0}=[1,\,-2]^{T}$ if the first iteration of the algorithm gives ${x}_{1}=[2,\,0]^{T}.$ Round your final answer to **three decimal places**.
${x}_{2}=[$ {{field-1}} $]$
{{field-2}}
question.worked_solution:
The Newton-Raphson method of optimizing a multivariable function $f:{R}^{n}\to R$ is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-[{H}_{f}({x}_{n})]^{-1}∇f({x}_{n}),
$$

where $H({x}_{n})$ and $∇f({x}_{n})$ are the Hessian and gradient of $f$, respectively, evaluated at ${x}_{n}.$

In our case, the gradient is

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f(x) & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}(2{x}^{2}y+4{x}^{2}-3xy-8x) \\ \frac{∂}{∂y}(2{x}^{2}y+4{x}^{2}-3xy-8x)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4xy+8x-3y-8 \\ 2{x}^{2}-3x\end{aligned}],\end{aligned}
$$

and the Hessian is

$$
\begin{aligned}{H}_{f}(x) & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}(4xy+8x-3y-8) & \frac{∂}{∂x}(2{x}^{2}-3x) \\ \frac{∂}{∂y}(4xy+8x-3y-8) & \frac{∂}{∂y}(2{x}^{2}-3x)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4y+8 & 4x-3 \\ 4x-3 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our Newton-Raphson formula is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-{[\begin{aligned}4y+8 & 4x-3 \\ 4x-3 & 0\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}^{-1}{[\begin{aligned}4xy+8x-3y-8 \\ 2{x}^{2}-3x\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}.
$$

For the second iteration, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & ={x}_{1}-{[\begin{aligned}4y+8 & 4x-3 \\ 4x-3 & 0\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{1}}^{-1}{[\begin{aligned}4xy+8x-3y-8 \\ 2{x}^{2}-3x\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{1}} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}4(0)+8 & 4(2)-3 \\ 4(2)-3 & 0\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}4(2)(0)+8(2)-3(0)-8 \\ 2(2)^{2}-3(2)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}8 & 5 \\ 5 & 0\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0\end{aligned}]-\frac{1}{8\cdot 0-5\cdot 5}[\begin{aligned}0 & -5 \\ -5 & 8\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}8 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+\frac{1}{25}[\begin{aligned}-10 \\ -24\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1.6 \\ -0.96\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
